sentences.en: Hey guys.
sentences.cn: 嘿，大家好。

sentences.en: In this video I'm going to talk about my two homes and how they're very different.
sentences.cn: 这个视频里我要聊聊我的两个家，还有它们有多不一样。

sentences.en: So I live about half the year in Japan and half the year in Thailand.
sentences.cn: 我一年大概一半时间住在日本，一半时间住在泰国

sentences.en: And my life is different in each place.
sentences.cn: 两边的生活很不一样。

sentences.en: So in Thailand, I don't cook much.
sentences.cn: 在泰国，我很少做饭

sentences.en: Actually, I don't cook at all because my little apartment does not have a kitchen, so I eat out often.
sentences.cn: 其实我完全不做饭，因为我那个小公寓没有厨房，所以我经常在外面吃。

sentences.en: Actually, I eat out all the time in Japan, though.
sentences.cn: 不过在日本，我倒是几乎天天在外面吃

sentences.en: I cook some In Japan.
sentences.cn: 在日本也会做一点。

sentences.en: I don't use the bus that much.
sentences.cn: 在日本我不太坐公交

sentences.en: I have a car, so I drive a lot.
sentences.cn: 我有车，所以经常开车。

sentences.en: But in Thailand, I don't drive at all.
sentences.cn: 但在泰国我完全不自己开车

sentences.en: I never drive actually.
sentences.cn: 真的一次都不开

sentences.en: So I either take the bus or I take the BTS.
sentences.cn: 我要么坐公交，要么坐 BTS。

sentences.en: So that's a little bit different.
sentences.cn: 这一点就不太一样。

sentences.en: Also in Japan, I don't walk much, don't walk around that much.
sentences.cn: 还有，在日本我走路不多，不太到处走。

sentences.en: But in Thailand, I walk around a lot.
sentences.cn: 但在泰国我走很多路

sentences.en: I walk to the park, I walk down the street.
sentences.cn: 走去公园，沿着街走

sentences.en: I'm just always walking.
sentences.cn: 我一直在走路。

sentences.en: So I kind of like that.
sentences.cn: 我还挺喜欢这样的。

sentences.en: In Japan, I speak Japanese, but I don't speak that much.
sentences.cn: 在日本我说日语，但说得不多

sentences.en: Actually.
sentences.cn: 说实话我也不

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.cn: 知道为什么。

sentences.en: I guess because people don't talk as much in Japan, and maybe my Japanese is not as good.
sentences.cn: 我猜是因为在日本大家话不多，也可能是我日语不够好。

sentences.en: But in Thailand, I speak Thai a lot, so maybe that's also a little bit different.
sentences.cn: 但在泰国，我经常说泰语，所以这可能也有点不一样。

sentences.en: In Thailand, I don't spend that much money, but Bangkok is getting more expensive.
sentences.cn: 在泰国我花钱不算多，不过曼谷越来越贵了。

sentences.en: And then where I live in Japan's not too expensive, so I don't spend that much money there, but I spend much more money on rent in Japan than I do in Thailand.
sentences.cn: 而我住的日本那边物价不太高，所以我在这两个地方花费都不算多，但我在日本花在房租上的钱比泰国多得多。

sentences.en: So both places are great.
sentences.cn: 所以这两个地方都很好

sentences.en: I love 'em, but they're just a little bit different.
sentences.cn: 我都很喜欢，只是有点不一样。
